messages:
maya: Dry-run failed for promo to eu-west. deploy-bot shows a values merge conflict in edgezone overlay. Can someone pin the chart or approve a hotpatch? cc @kyra

sven: On it. Which chart/version and any logs?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: DRY-RUN FAILED
service payments: helm template errored: merge conflict in values 'edgezone'.
Command: helm upgrade --install payments ./charts/payments --dry-run --values values/eu.yaml --values overlays/edgezone.yaml
Error: conflicting keys: 'connectionTimeout' present in both base and overlay with different types
See logs: http://ci.internal/DRY-12345

maya: We tried auto-merge but overlay uses string '30s' vs int 30. I don't want to change overlay without a quick review.

jordan: We can pin to payments@1.4.2 and promote, then follow up with a hotpatch to normalize the values. Pin is lower risk.

sven: Agree. If we pin we need a release-notes blurb + manual promotion. Who will push the pin?

kyra: @sven I can do the pin and run the promotion. ETA ~15m.

ops-bot: k8s: canary pods for payments-eu reported 0/1 ready earlier due to liveness probe flapping in canary. Metric: readiness 78% over 5m.

maya: Can we hold promotion until canary stabilizes? Last time a readiness dip caused customer errors.

jordan: Pinning prevents introducing new chart changes mid-merge. Suggest: pin + run canary at 10% traffic. If stable, increase.

sven: Plan: 1) pin payments chart to 1.4.2 in overlays 2) update release notes 'pin to avoid values-type drift' 3) promote canary at 10% for 30m 4) if healthy escalate, else rollback.

kyra: I'm doing the pin now. Commands I'm running:
```
# pin chart version
kubectl -n infra exec -it config-editor -- sed -i 's/chartVersion:.*/chartVersion: "1.4.2"/' overlays/edgezone/values.yaml
git add overlays/edgezone/values.yaml && git commit -m "pin payments chart to 1.4.2 to avoid values merge type drift" && git push
```
This will trigger deploy-bot after merge.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Received PR merge event. Starting canary with pinned chart 1.4.2 at 10% traffic. Canary job id CAN-1789.

ops-bot: k8s: canary started. pods: payments-eu-canary x3. Ready 3/3.

maya: :thumbsup: Thanks kyra. Drafting release note: - pinned payments chart to 1.4.2 to avoid values overlay merge conflict - follow-up hotpatch to normalize 'connectionTimeout' types - canary 10% for 30m
Draft blurb: "Pinned payments chart to 1.4.2 while we investigate values schema drift in edgezone overlay. This prevents accidental type coercion during merges."

jordan: Also add rollback steps:
```
# rollback
helm rollback payments <prev-release> --namespace prod
kubectl rollout status deploy/payments -n prod
```
and contact oncall #infra if rollback needed.

sven: If canary shows probe failures we abort and rollback. Keep noise to channel.

ops-bot: canary metrics at 15m: latency +2%, errors +0.1%, readiness 98%. No regression.

maya: Looks stable. kyra, bump to 50%?

kyra: Bumping to 50% now. deploy-bot: route-canary CAN-1789 set-traffic 50%

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: traffic updated to 50% for CAN-1789.

ops-bot: Canary 50% steady at 20m: latency +1%, errors unchanged.

maya: Proceed to 100% in 10m unless objections.

jordan: No objections.

sven: Fine with me.

kyra: Promoting to 100% now. deploy-bot: promote CAN-1789

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: promoted canary CAN-1789 to stable release payments@1.4.2. Notifying release-notes-bot.

release-notes-bot: release-notes-bot: Added entry under 2024-11-23: 'Pinned payments chart to 1.4.2; follow-up hotpatch planned'.

ops-bot: prod rollout: rollout completed. pods ready 6/6. No alerts.

maya: Closing here once release notes link posted.

release-notes-bot: release-notes-bot: https://releases.internal/notes/2024-11-23/payments-pin

sven: Thanks all. If this repeats we'll open a short postmortem and normalize the values schema.
